pages.title: About - Nexus Network Technologies
pages.meta: We are based in Raleigh, NC and work dynamically with our clients, operating in a virtual work-space and on-site to make collaboration seamless. Our combined experience allows us to translate business challenges into technical solutions that create immediate benefits to the organizations we support. We pass these savings along to our clients and thereby offer more affordable rates than our typical competitors. We build partnerships with local and national technology providers to offer our clients solutions that align with their needs. By maintaining strong vendor relationships, we are able to secure competitive pricing that is dramatically lower than what other providers can offer.
